about: Amy Brimah is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Denver, Colorado area. Providing legal representation in Colorado for a variety of different issues, Amy Brimah was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Amy Brimah attended law school. Amy Brimah was enrolled at University of Colorado Law School. She earned a juris doctor degree in 2000. Amy Brimah was admitted to the practice of law in 2000.

Attorneys like Amy Brimah are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Amy Brimah represents clients with Real Estate: Business issues. Additional legal issues represented include Land Use / Zoning.
